_rulescope_notes: Role for the catalog workflows (PUT /api/security/role/rulescope-catalog, or rulescope-catalog-<space> per space). Keys starting with _rulescope are removed before sending.
The installer replaces __SPACES__ with ["*"] for the global scope, or ["<space id>"] for a per-space copy.
view_index_metadata on logs-* lets _resolve/index list the data streams a rule's patterns match. The catalog never reads events, so it has no read on logs-*.
Scheduled runs use the identity of the account that last saved the workflow, so give this role to a dedicated user and set RULESCOPE_CATALOG_WORKFLOW_API_KEY.
